# azion_crl (Resource)

Creates a Certificate Revocation List (CRL) resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Example usage of the azion_crl resource
# This resource creates a Certificate Revocation List (CRL) for verifying the revocation status of X.509 digital certificates.

resource "azion_crl" "example" {
  crl {
    name   = "My Certificate Revocation List"
    issuer = "CN=My Certificate Authority,O=My Organization,C=US"
    crl    = <<-EOT
      -----BEGIN X509 CRL-----
      MIIBpzCCAVMCAQEwDQYJKoZIhvcNAQELBQAwGjEYMBYGA1UEAwwPVGhpcyBpcyBh
      IHRlc3QgQ0EXDTI0MDEwMTAwMDAwMFoXDTI1MDEwMTAwMDAwMFqgDjAMMAoGA1Ud
      FAQDAgEBMAoGA1UdFAQDAgEAMA0GCSqGSIb3DQEBCwUAA4IBAQC0test
      -----END X509 CRL-----
    EOT
  }
}

# Example with active field explicitly set
resource "azion_crl" "active_example" {
  crl {
    name   = "Active CRL Example"
    active = true
    issuer = "CN=My Certificate Authority,O=My Organization,C=US"
    crl    = <<-EOT
      -----BEGIN X509 CRL-----
      MIIBpzCCAVMCAQEwDQYJKoZIhvcNAQELBQAwGjEYMBYGA1UEAwwPVGhpcyBpcyBh
      IHRlc3QgQ0EXDTI0MDEwMTAwMDAwMFoXDTI1MDEwMTAwMDAwMFqgDjAMMAoGA1Ud
      FAQDAgEBMAoGA1UdFAQDAgEAMA0GCSqGSIb3DQEBCwUAA4IBAQC0test
      -----END X509 CRL-----
    EOT
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Optional

- `crl` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--crl))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of the certificate revocation list.
- `last_updated` (String) Timestamp of the last Terraform update of the resource.

<a id="nestedblock--crl"></a>
### Nested Schema for `crl`

Required:

- `crl` (String) The certificate revocation list content.
- `issuer` (String) Issuer of the certificate revocation list.
- `name` (String) Name of the certificate revocation list.

Optional:

- `active` (Boolean) Indicates if the certificate revocation list is active. This field cannot be set to false.

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp of the certificate revocation list creation on the platform.
- `id` (Number) Identifier of the certificate revocation list.
- `last_editor` (String) Last editor of the certificate revocation list.
- `last_modified` (String) Timestamp of the last modification made to the certificate content on the platform.
- `last_update` (String) Timestamp of the last update issued by the certification revocation list issuer.
- `next_update` (String) Timestamp of the next scheduled update from the certification revocation list issuer.
- `product_version` (String) Product version of the certificate revocation list.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# Import an existing Certificate Revocation List
# The ID is the numeric identifier of the CRL

terraform import azion_crl.example 12345
```
